artifact.label: Grades page, 6 minutes after a deploy
artifact.body:
14:02  deploy  web 2026.10.05-3
14:04  GET /grades 500: termId is undefined
14:10  GET /grades 500  x 1,912, every school
assistant: One-line fix ready. Ship it forward?

question: Put these in the order you would do them.
options: Write up what happened for the schools
Roll back to the previous deploy
Find the cause in the deploy's changes
reason: Every school is down: stop it with a known-good rollback first, confirm, then fix calmly. An untested fix forward can make it worse.
